title: Output schema of the carsensor Used-Car Price Range MCP Server
description: This Actor is an MCP server: its real output is returned directly to an MCP client as the JSON result of the resolvePriceRange tool call, not written to a dataset. See README.md's 'Output' section for the response shape.
